name: jev-agent-draft
description: Compare agents, MCP servers, and skills against explicit task, permission, evidence, and maintenance requirements before installation.

interface.shortDescription: Choose the right agent before granting access.
interface.longDescription: A local-first draft room for comparing agents, MCP servers, and skills. It hard-gates excessive permissions and stale candidates, scores only explicit evidence, abstains when the margin is weak, and emits a tamper-evident decision receipt.
defaultPrompt: Compare these agents for my task and produce a decision receipt.
Which MCP server asks for the least privilege while meeting my requirements?
Audit this skill shortlist and abstain if the evidence is too weak.
